caption: The drawing depicts a single figure of a man standing in profile, facing to the left. The man is dressed in a blue military-style uniform with a matching peaked cap, both of which have yellow or gold accents. His jacket is dark blue with two white chevrons on the upper arm, gold buttons, and a tall, buttoned collar. He wears light blue trousers with a white vertical stripe running down the outer side of each leg, and black shoes. The man's arms are crossed over his chest, and he sports a dark mustache. He holds a cigarette in his mouth, which is angled upward. The figure stands on a light gray rectangular platform. The background is a plain, beige or tan color, and there is a signature reading "Eugene Croe" in blue in the lower right corner.
title: Cigar Store Soldier
